accounting.allocation: Allocate each independently evidenced source cost once across registered cost centres; disclose shared incidents and dependence.
accounting.completeness: Complete cost-centre incident ledger plus attributable invoices/worklogs and an independent final completeness attestation; an empty log is not zero.
excluded: Routine controls and already-budgeted operating cost
Missed sales, fines, premiums, customer/patient losses
Double-counted shared incident costs, forecast-generated outcomes and synthetic tests
accounting.finality: Year-end independent reconciliation and signed final/complete record; unresolved or disputed amounts are ineligible. Closing within 31 days is a process target.
included: Incremental incident-response and restoration labour at an agreed charge-out rule, supported by worklogs
Actual incremental restoration/vendor invoices allocated once to a registered cost centre
accounting.recognition: Recognize eligible expense by incurred UTC date in the registered subject-year, not incident onset, payment or recording date. Annual frequency counts incidents with eligible recovery activity in that year, including carry-in; severity is only their eligible within-year incremental direct expense, excluding carry-out.
accounting.unit_basis: nominal direct security-incident recovery expense per registered subject-year

lef_basis.statement: Delegated prospective institution-year planning policy, not measured frequency: use a common PERT annual incident-frequency range [0.25, 1, 3] for incidents with eligible recovery activity incurred during 2027, including carry-in. One incident/year is a planning reserve reference; lower/upper parameters are chosen uncertainty bounds, not evidence-derived rates or a real-world cap. No workload contingencies were summed, no known/future outcomes were fitted, and identical policy across the three institutions does not establish independent incidents.

lm_basis.statement: Delegated prospective per-incident within-year expense budget, not measured staffing/payroll/loss: planned incremental labour [10, 40, 160] hours at an explicitly adopted GBP100/hour charge-out rule plus illustrative incremental vendor/restoration allowances [0, 1000, 4000] GBP gives PERT [1000, 5000, 20000] GBP. Forty hours is one planning work-week of aggregate recovery capacity, never a statement about employee count or available staff. These are distribution parameters, not quantiles, invoice forecasts or actual-expense caps. Count only eligible expense incurred within 2027; no carry-out, routine operating cost, lost sales/fines/premiums/customer losses or control-effectiveness credit.
